title: Effects of Chlorine and Methyl Substitution on Structure, IR, and Raman Spectra of the Biomolecule 6-Chloro-3-methyluracil in Isolated and Solid States and in Base-Pair Formation.
authors: Palafox, Mauricio Alcolea; Belskaya, Nataliya P; Hristova-Avakumova, Nadya G; Kostova, Irena P
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氯代甲基尿嘧啶的结构与光谱性质及其与腺嘌呤碱基配对，虽涉及核酸碱基配对和分子对接，但核心是光谱与电子结构分析，非TF-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD结合机制建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The effect of the chlorine atom in the sixth position and methyl group in the third position of the uracil ring on the structural parameters, NBO charge distribution, and molecular properties of the 6-chloro-3-methyluracil (M6CU) biomolecule was analyzed in the isolated state, solid-state arrangement and within a double-stranded RNA microhelix. This effect, which was also compared to those with uracil and several uracil derivatives, leads to higher reactivity and the special properties of this pharmaceutical compound. Several correlations were established using MP2 and several DFT methods. The structural characterization of M6CU and a detailed analysis of the experimental FT-IR and FT-Raman spectra in the solid state was another aim studied in detail. For an accurate assignment, a simple approximation to a crystalline unit cell was optimized using a trimer form and the wavenumbers were subsequently corrected using several scaling procedures. The modified nucleobase M6CU forms base pairs with the complementary adenine and, therefore, it could replace uracil in the helix; based on our calculations, it leads to a noticeable helix deformation. This computational finding suggests its possible potential effect by binding to cancer-related or viral RNA helices. Molecular docking also revealed that M6CU could act as an active ligand within the 1JPW active site of the target beta-catenin/Tcf4 protein complex.
abstract_zh: 分析了尿嘧啶环第六位氯原子和第三位甲基对6-氯-3-甲基尿嘧啶（M6CU）生物分子在孤立态、固态排列及双链RNA微螺旋中的结构参数、NBO电荷分布和分子性质的影响。该效应还与尿嘧啶及若干尿嘧啶衍生物进行了比较，导致该药物化合物具有更高的反应性和特殊性质。利用MP2和多种DFT方法建立了若干相关性。M6CU的结构表征以及固态下实验FT-IR和FT-Raman光谱的详细分析是另一项详细研究的目标。为进行准确归属，采用三聚体形式对晶胞的简单近似进行了优化，并随后使用多种缩放程序对波数进行了校正。修饰核碱基M6CU与互补腺嘌呤形成碱基对，因此它可能在螺旋中替代尿嘧啶；根据我们的计算，这会导致明显的螺旋变形。这一计算发现提示其可能通过与癌症相关或病毒RNA螺旋结合而产生潜在效应。分子对接还揭示，M6CU可作为靶标β-catenin/Tcf4蛋白复合物1JPW活性位点内的活性配体。
